value: A disguise opens a way to records guarded by suspicion and old allegiances. The faction quest asks its chosen seeker to recover the ancient dragonforged blades’ history, not to invent a new forging tale. In this retelling, the folio is an interpretive emblem for that record. A successful theft is a game objective; the chronicle keeps the danger and purpose, not every repeated step of play.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
